skills.name: Country Scene
skills.text: During Da Qiao's turn, she can use any diamond-suited card as Capture.

skills.name: Displace
skills.text: When Da Qiao is the target of an attack, she can discard any card to redirect the attack to any other player within her attacking range other than the source.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
